fixed_null_nuisance_argument: Residualize each outcome against source-day cells and all non-H covariates once. The numerator Hstar.T@Yres is linear in corrected Hstar; its sign determines OLS slope whenever Hstar residual sum of squares is positive. Ranking beneficial signed numerator reductions yields the minimum unit-cost point-sign crossing in each declared correction class.
limitations: Arbitrary outcome-informed hypothetical corrections; not actual annotation errors, realistic-error constraints, interval-sign thresholds or behavioral validity. No new raw texts or labels.
